fact: Somalia's Ministry of Communications and Technology held a consultative meeting, opened by the State Minister, on the Zero Draft of the National Framework for Digital Interoperability and Integration, with the Office of the Prime Minister, ministries and key institutions, which concluded by adopting strategic directions.
title: Director General of the Somali Data Protection Authority (DPA), Eng. Mohamed Nur Olow, participated in the Consultative Meeting on the National Digital Interoperability Framework
